facts.text: The resort is on one of Cabo's only swimmable beaches.
facts.excerpt: Located on one of Cabo's only swimmable beaches, Chileno Bay hits just the right balance between sophistication and cool.

facts.text: The resort's address is Carretera Transpeninsular San Jose-San Lucas Km. 15, Playa Chileno Bay, Cabo San Lucas.
facts.excerpt: Carretera Transpeninsular San Jose-San Lucas Km. 15, Playa Chileno Bay, 23410 Cabo San Lucas, B.C.S., Mexico

facts.text: The architecture uses sandstone brick and white stucco and blends into the desert setting.
facts.excerpt: The architecture, with its sandstone brick and white stucco, blends beautifully into the desert setting

facts.text: Rooms are scattered around two infinity pools, and most look out over the Pacific.
facts.excerpt: Rooms are scattered around two gorgeous infinity pools, and most look out over the Pacific.

facts.text: One of the two pools is for adults only and the other is for families.
facts.excerpt: there's one that's just for adults, and one for the family

facts.text: The restaurant Comal serves modern takes on traditional Mexican dishes, spotlighting organic and local ingredients.
facts.excerpt: The restaurant, Comal, does Mexican 2.0—modern takes on traditional dishes, spotlighting organic and local ingredients

facts.text: A taco bar on the beach offers a few different options each day.
facts.excerpt: taco bar right on the beach that offers a few different options each day

facts.text: Guests can borrow snorkeling equipment and paddle boards at the beach.
facts.excerpt: snorkeling equipment and paddle boards you can borrow
The wifi was strong and free.

facts.text: The three-bedroom oceanfront villa has a kitchen with a living room opening onto a patio with a small private pool overlooking the Pacific.
facts.excerpt: a spacious kitchen with top of the line appliances that you can actually cook with, and a living room area that opened onto a large patio with a small private pool overlooking the Pacific.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the resort in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2018 through 2026.
The resort received Five Star in Forbes Travel Guide's 2021 Star Awards.
facts.excerpt: Chileno Bay Resort and Residences, Auberge Collection receives Five Star in Forbes Travel Guide's 2021 Star Awards

facts.text: The resort skews younger and hipper than most resorts in Cabo.
facts.excerpt: it skews younger and hipper than most resorts in Cabo
